name: Vesper
description: Inhabits the lighting systems along the Old Harbor waterfront and creates a specific warm amber illumination at sunset that doesn't match any programmed lighting schedule.
observed_behavior: Activates decorative lighting along the waterfront during the 30-minute window around sunset. The color temperature shifts to match the actual sky conditions.
story_hooks: Vesper's sunset lighting has become a tourist attraction that nobody arranged. The harbor residents are protective of it. They don't want anyone to 'fix' it.
